desc:
🧺 Run your very own dry cleaner!

Customers walk in with stained, wrinkly clothes, and it's up to you to make them spotless!

🧽 SCRUB stains with the right cleaner (ketchup, oil, cocoa, grass and more)
🌀 WASH clothes in the big cleaning machine
👔 IRON out every wrinkle
🛍️ BAG it, hang it on the rail and hand it back for cash and tips!

⭐ Do a perfect job for 5 stars and bigger tips
👥 Meet 40 unique customers, from Common to Legendary, and collect them all in your Index
🧑‍🔧 Hire staff: a Cashier, Washer, Spotter, Presser and Bagger who work while you're away
⬆️ Upgrade your tools and level up your shop to unlock the Back Room
🎁 Daily rewards, offline earnings and a free reward for joining the group!

Can you build the best dry cleaner in town? 🏆

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite for updates!
